story: Ty Jerome hit seven threes for 29, Memphis made all 24 of its free throws, and the Grizzlies held off Charlotte 117–111.
aria: Animated Short: Ty Jerome's 3-pointer with a little under five minutes 40 left that answered a Charlotte three and made it 108–98 on the way to a 117–111 Grizzlies win at Charlotte. An original illustration, not traced from footage, not to scale.
